title: Episode 206: 🇳🇱 C++ Under the Sea Live 🇳🇱 Jason Turner, Inbal Levi & More!

sentences.en: And, we've just slid past it.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们刚刚好滑过去了。

sentences.en: Fan favorite here, folks.
sentences.zh: 各位，这可是大家的最爱。

sentences.en: Jason Turner, host of CppCast from, I believe, episode 4 to 349.
sentences.zh: 杰森·特纳，CppCast 播客的主持人，大概从第 4 期到第 349 期吧。

sentences.en: I want to clarify some of my earlier statements.
sentences.zh: 我想澄清一下我之前的一些言论。

sentences.en: For legal reasons, I have to say those were jokes.
sentences.zh: 出于法律原因，我必须说那些都是开玩笑。

sentences.en: I like all podcasts equally well.
sentences.zh: 我对所有播客的喜爱都是一样的。

sentences.en: We caught the Pokemon before, I don't know, I didn't actually play Pokemon, so did they hop back into a forest or something?
sentences.zh: 我们抓住了宝可梦，在——我不知道，我其实没玩过宝可梦，所以它们是会跳回森林里还是怎么着？

sentences.en: Welcome to ADSP, the podcast, episode 206, recorded on October 11, 2024.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听 ADSP 播客第 206 期，录制于 2024 年 10 月 11 日。

sentences.en: My name is Connor, and today with my co-host, Bryce, we interview both keynote speakers live from C++ Under the Sea,
sentences.zh: 我是康纳，今天和我的联合主持人布莱斯一起，我们在 C++ Under the Sea 会议现场采访两位主题演讲嘉宾，

sentences.en: as well as three other guests, Kuhn Pop, Jan Williams, and briefly, Jonathan Mueller again.
sentences.zh: 以及其他三位嘉宾，库恩·波普、扬·威尔曼斯，还有简短再次露面的乔纳森·穆勒。

sentences.en: Introduce yourself, Jan, or I'll hand the mic to Bryce, and then introduce yourself.
sentences.zh: 扬，自我介绍一下，不然我就把麦克风交给布莱斯，然后再让你自我介绍。

sentences.en: Tell us how you enjoyed the inaugural edition of C++ Under the Sea.
sentences.zh: 跟我们聊聊你对首届 C++ Under the Sea 的感受。

sentences.en: So, serious face, introduce yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以，摆出严肃的表情，自我介绍一下吧。

sentences.en: I don't think you've been on the podcast before.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你以前没上过这个播客。

sentences.en: I haven't.
sentences.zh: 我没有。

sentences.en: My name is Jan Wilmans.
sentences.zh: 我叫扬·威尔曼斯。

sentences.en: I'm software architect for Vimac.
sentences.zh: 我是 Vimac 的软件架构师。

sentences.en: Yeah, what can I tell about myself?
sentences.zh: 对，我能介绍点什么呢？

sentences.en: I also do C++ coaching.
sentences.zh: 我也做 C++ 辅导。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that's it a bit.
sentences.zh: 所以，差不多就是这样吧。

sentences.en: I have a website called nullpointer.nl, where you can find some information.
sentences.zh: 我有一个网站叫 nullpointer.nl，你可以在上面找到一些信息。

sentences.en: Nullpointer.nl, that's a good domain name.
sentences.zh: Nullpointer.nl，真是个好域名。

sentences.en: Did you teach a course at this conference?
sentences.zh: 你在这次会议上授课了吗？

sentences.en: I did not.
sentences.zh: 我没有。

sentences.en: I generally don't teach courses for the public, just inside the company.
sentences.zh: 我一般不在公开场合授课，只在公司内部。

sentences.en: Ah, okay.
sentences.zh: 啊，好吧。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 很有意思。

sentences.en: And so, what does the company that you work for, whose name I'm not going to try to pronounce,
sentences.zh: 那么，你工作的这家公司——它的名字我可不打算试着去读——

sentences.en: Vimac?
sentences.zh: Vimac？

sentences.en: Vimac?
sentences.zh: Vimac？

sentences.en: It's not too difficult, I think.
sentences.zh: 我觉得不太难读。

sentences.en: It wasn't that bad.
sentences.zh: 其实没那么难。

sentences.en: What do they do?
sentences.zh: 他们是做什么的？

sentences.en: Oh, we make a quality inspection system for glass.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们制造玻璃质量检测系统。

sentences.en: So, vials, syringes, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 比如药瓶、注射器之类东西。

sentences.en: Medical glass.
sentences.zh: 医用玻璃。

sentences.en: I have noticed that glass and mirrors seems to be a very Dutch thing.
sentences.zh: 我发现玻璃和镜子似乎是一件很荷兰的事。

sentences.en: Like, the mirrors that go into the lithography machines, they make them in the Netherlands.
sentences.zh: 比如光刻机里用的镜子，就是荷兰制造的。

sentences.en: And, like, for, like, a lot of the telescopes, they make the big mirrors here in the Netherlands.
sentences.zh: 还有，很多望远镜的大型镜面也是在这里，在荷兰制造的。

sentences.en: Like, what is the Dutch obsession with glass?
sentences.zh: 话说荷兰人对玻璃怎么有一种执念？

sentences.en: I don't know the answer to that question, but, yeah, we focus on the quality of glass and not the production of glass, let's say.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这个问题的答案，不过，好吧，我们专注于玻璃的质量，而不是玻璃的生产，可以说吧。

sentences.en: So, yeah, so we basically pick up products, rotate them, make sort of Google maps of the outside of the surface of the glass, and then do image processing to find flaws.
sentences.zh: 所以，基本上我们就是拿起产品，旋转它们，给玻璃外表面拍个类似“谷歌地图”的东西，然后通过图像处理来寻找瑕疵。

sentences.en: So, cracks, bubbles, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 比如裂纹、气泡之类的。

sentences.en: And also, we use optical setups to see if there are stress, if there are signs of stress in the glass.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们还使用光学装置来观察玻璃中是否存在应力，是否有应力迹象。

sentences.en: So, that means if there are, if there's stress in glass, then it breaks when you drop it, basically.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，如果玻璃里有应力，基本上你把它一摔就会碎。

sentences.en: So, it's fragile.
sentences.zh: 所以它很脆弱。

sentences.en: That's, yeah, that is my, that's the characteristic of glass that I think of the most, that it is fairly fragile.
sentences.zh: 这，对，这是我对玻璃感触最深的特性，那就是它相当脆弱。

sentences.en: But also, it can be strong.
sentences.zh: 但它也可以很坚固。

sentences.en: It's just like if it breaks, it, you know, shatters.
sentences.zh: 只不过如果它碎了，你知道的，就会粉碎。

sentences.en: And what was your favorite talk of the conference?
sentences.zh: 你最喜欢这次会议的哪场演讲？

sentences.en: I think it was your talk, actually.
sentences.zh: 我想实际上是你的演讲。

sentences.en: Oh, my talk.
sentences.zh: 哦，我的演讲。

sentences.en: Oh, how much did I pay you to say that?
sentences.zh: 哦，我付了你多少钱让你这么说？

sentences.en: Well, we said we wouldn't discuss that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们说过不讨论这个的。

sentences.en: But, no, I think it was why I liked it the best is because it's a topic that I never thought about before.
sentences.zh: 不过，没有啦，我最喜欢的原因是因为这是一个我以前从未思考过的话题。

sentences.en: So, just the in-depth ordering of things and the sequence of operations that us, what guarantees do you actually get in that order?
sentences.zh: 也就是说，关于事物的深度排序和操作序列，在那种顺序中你实际上能得到什么保证？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: And I think the difference between happens before and happens before was really interesting.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为“先发生”（happened-before）和“先发生”（happens-before）之间的区别真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: So, it doesn't actually mean it will happen before, in sequence, in time, let's say.
sentences.zh: 所以它并不一定意味着它在顺序上、时间上真的会先发生，可以说吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, that was really interesting.
sentences.zh: 对，那真的很有意思。

sentences.en: Well, Jason's talk was also interesting because of the way he specified the possible operations that you can do on types.
sentences.zh: 嗯，杰森的演讲也很有趣，因为他指定了你对类型可以执行的可能操作的方式。

sentences.en: And it was really interesting to just sort of complete the circle between, yeah, I want my own unique type and I want to specify the operations on the type.
sentences.zh: 而且把这个闭环补全真的很有意思，就是：没错，我想要我自己的独特类型，我想要指定该类型的操作。

sentences.en: But I don't want to go into a super complicated const expert world of how to tell the compiler exactly what I mean.
sentences.zh: 但我不想陷入超级复杂的 consteval/constexpr 世界去准确告诉编译器我的意思。

sentences.en: So, this was, let's say, a syntax that allows you to express what you want without knowing all the details of the template syntax behind it.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个语法，可以说它允许你表达你想要的东西，而不需要了解其背后的模板语法的全部细节。

sentences.en: So, for background, for those who were not at the conference,
sentences.zh: 所以，作为背景补充，对于那些没有参加会议的人，

sentences.en: I gave a talk about the C++ execution model where I actually go through and read a large chunk of the C++ standard that describes the execution model
sentences.zh: 我做了一个关于 C++ 执行模型的演讲，我实际翻阅并阅读了 C++ 标准中描述执行模型的大量篇幅，

sentences.en: and then explain some of the implications and the real world, you know, impacts of what this all means.
sentences.zh: 然后解释了这一切所带来的一些现实影响和实际意义。

sentences.en: And then Jason gave a talk about.
sentences.zh: 然后杰森做了一个关于……的演讲。

sentences.en: What did I give a talk about?
sentences.zh: 我做了一个关于什么的演讲？

sentences.en: Stronger typing.
sentences.zh: 更强的类型系统。

sentences.en: That's what it was about.
sentences.zh: 对，就是关于这个的。

sentences.en: And yes, as Jan said, I just really wanted to inspire people on why you want stronger typing in your code.
sentences.zh: 是的，正如扬所说，我只是真的很想激励大家，为什么在代码中你需要更强的类型。

sentences.en: But then I also showed some, I don't know, some goofy concepts, tricks, basically,
sentences.zh: 但随后我也展示了一些，我不知道，一些古怪的概念，基本上是一些技巧，

sentences.en: for how you might convince the compiler to implement those functions for you that you want on your strongly typed types.
sentences.zh: 教你如何说服编译器为你实现那些你想要的强类型上的函数。

sentences.en: You're strong types.
sentences.zh: 你的强类型。

sentences.en: Anyhow, I think it was a pretty good talk.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，我觉得这是一场相当不错的演讲。

sentences.en: I think it worked out.
sentences.zh: 我觉得效果不错。

sentences.en: I thought it was pretty good, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我也觉得挺好的。

sentences.en: I was finishing slides, so I was half there, half not.
sentences.zh: 我当时还在赶幻灯片，所以心不在焉的。

sentences.en: But we're passing as we count them.
sentences.zh: 不过我们在边走边数，顺便就过去了。

sentences.en: And we've just slid past it.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们刚刚好滑过去了。

sentences.en: Fan favorite here, folks.
sentences.zh: 各位，这可是大家的最爱。

sentences.en: Jason Turner.
sentences.zh: 杰森·特纳。

sentences.en: I was just about to say, you should introduce us.
sentences.zh: 我正要说呢，你该给我们介绍一下。

sentences.en: Host of CppCast from, I believe, episode 4 to 359, 4?
sentences.zh: CppCast 的主持人，从第 4 期到第 349 期，是 4 期吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: He knows.
sentences.zh: 他自己知道。

sentences.en: And then guest co-host for 350 when we handed it off to Phil and Timor.
sentences.zh: 然后是第 350 期的特邀联合主持人，当时我们把接力棒交给了菲尔和蒂莫尔。

sentences.en: This is true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And not only, I mean, you're listening to a podcast right now, so I'm sure there's like a 75% overlap of our listeners with CppCaSt.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，我的意思是，你现在正在听播客，所以我敢肯定我们的听众和 CppCast 有大约 75% 的重合度。

sentences.en: But also, according to your talk this morning, 454?
sentences.zh: 而且，根据你今天早上的演讲，是 454？

sentences.en: Five?
sentences.zh: 还是 5？

sentences.en: 455 weeks straight of C++ Weekly.
sentences.zh: 连续 455 周的 C++ Weekly。

sentences.en: Everyone's?
sentences.zh: 大家都……？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It's in that ball.
sentences.zh: 差不多那个数。

sentences.en: North of 450, so we've got, and also north of 100,000 subscribers, you've got your silver YouTube play button.
sentences.zh: 超过 450 期了，而且订阅者也超过了 10 万，你拿到了 YouTube 的白银创作者奖牌。

sentences.en: Has that arrived in the mail?
sentences.zh: 那个寄到信箱里了吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，对，对。

sentences.en: I've had the silver play button for about a year now.
sentences.zh: 我拿到银播放按钮大约有一年了。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: No, don't need to rub it in us other YouTubers' faces that haven't hit that milestone.
sentences.zh: 行了，别在我们这些还没达到这个里程碑的油管博主面前显摆了。

sentences.en: How many subscribers do you have?
sentences.zh: 你有多少订阅者？

sentences.en: I have less than 100,000.
sentences.zh: 我不到 10 万。

sentences.en: Okay, so an interesting thing here is I did a side series just on computer science topics for like five weeks or something.
sentences.zh: 好的，这里有个有趣的事情，我曾经做过一个仅关于计算机科学主题的衍生系列，大概持续了五周左右吧。

sentences.en: I did two episodes extra per week to try to just introduce other computer science topics for people who are interested in learning how to program.
sentences.zh: 我每周多做两期节目，试图为那些对学习编程感兴趣的人介绍其他计算机科学主题。

sentences.en: That massively hurt my channel.
sentences.zh: 这给我的频道带来了毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: I went from an average of 1,000 new subscribers a month that I could count on down to 600 new subscribers a month when I was releasing new content to reach a wider audience.
sentences.zh: 我原本每个月稳定的 1,000 个新订阅者，在我发布新内容以吸引更广泛受众时，暴跌到了每月 600 个新订阅者。

sentences.en: And it took about seven months for that to recover back up to 1,000 subscribers a month after I stopped that.
sentences.zh: 在我停止这样做之后，花了大约七个月的时间才恢复到每月 1,000 个订阅者的水平。

sentences.en: What do you have theories as to why that was?
sentences.zh: 你对造成这种情况有什么理论解释吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, do you have theories?
sentences.zh: 对，你有什么看法？

sentences.en: I think I just simply wasn't getting the C++ programmer subscribing anymore, and I was losing some subscribers who didn't want that extra content.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很简单，就是不再有 C++ 程序员来订阅了，而且我还失去了一些不想要这些额外内容的订阅者。

sentences.en: It's a fun fact about YouTube subscribers is they're not willing to simply skip videos that they don't like.
sentences.zh: 关于 YouTube 订阅者，一个有趣的事实是，他们根本不愿意直接跳过自己不喜欢的视频。

sentences.en: I was once told I got a comment on a YouTube video because I change what I post videos on depending on what I'm interested in.
sentences.zh: 我曾经收到过一条 YouTube 视频的评论，因为我发布视频的内容会根据我的兴趣而改变。

sentences.en: And one of the comments I got once was, please stop holding us hostage with your array language content and go back to C++ algorithMs.
sentences.zh: 我收到的其中一条评论是：请别再用你的数组语言内容绑架我们了，快滚回去搞 C++ 算法吧。

sentences.en: And it made me laugh so hard because there's a subscribe button you can click to unsubscribe, and nobody's holding anybody's hostage.
sentences.zh: 这把我逗得哈哈大笑，因为明明有一个叫“订阅”的按钮你可以点一下来取消订阅，根本没人绑架任何人。

sentences.en: Connor, you as a YouTuber should know.
sentences.zh: 康纳，你作为一名油管博主应该知道的。

sentences.en: Don't tell them that there's a way to unsubscribe.
sentences.zh: 别告诉他们有取消订阅这回事。

sentences.en: Some of them may not know that they can unsubscribe.
sentences.zh: 他们中有些人可能不知道自己可以取消订阅。

sentences.en: They may think it's a one-way door.
sentences.zh: 他们可能觉得这是一条单行道。

sentences.en: That works in your favor.
sentences.zh: 这对你有利。

sentences.en: So you think you were upsetting folks that wanted purely C++ content, and somehow the algorithm figured that out.
sentences.zh: 所以你认为你惹恼了那些只想看纯 C++ 内容的人，算法不知怎么也搞清楚了这一点。

sentences.en: Although if I do occasional travel logs about places where C++ has taken me, I get pretty good responses to those.
sentences.zh: 不过，如果我偶尔发一些关于 C++ 带我去过的地方的旅行日志，大家的反应倒还挺好的。

sentences.en: Much lower views, but at least people aren't unsubscribing or complaining.
sentences.zh: 观看量低得多，但至少人们不会取消订阅或抱怨。

sentences.en: I just start the episode by saying, hey, this is a travel log.
sentences.zh: 我只是在视频开头说，嘿，这是一段旅行日志。

sentences.en: If you don't want to watch it, you should skip it.
sentences.zh: 如果你不想看，应该跳过它。

sentences.en: So Connor, you should talk about your talk because I have an update on your talk.
sentences.zh: 所以康纳，你该聊聊你的演讲了，因为我关于你的演讲有最新进展。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: We'll talk about my talk later.
sentences.zh: 我们待会儿再聊我的演讲。

sentences.en: Well, because Jason's got to bounce.
sentences.zh: 好吧，因为杰森得赶飞机了。

sentences.en: He's heading back.
sentences.zh: 他要回去了。

sentences.en: We just talked about that.
sentences.zh: 我们刚说过这个。

sentences.en: Both Jan and Jason are bouncing.
sentences.zh: 扬和杰森都要走了。

sentences.en: Which is why, I mean, we were looking for you at lunch, and then there was a break, but we didn't end up recording at the break.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么，我的意思是，我们在午餐时找过你，后来休息了，但我们最终没有在休息期间录制。

sentences.en: So now we're at the IMC-sponsored.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们是在 IMC 赞助的……

sentences.en: Yes, I was trying to avoid you.
sentences.zh: 对，我当时在躲着你们。

sentences.en: That's what.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: You were going to come up with an excuse, and then you realized, no, I wasn't doing anything.
sentences.zh: 你本打算找个借口，然后意识到，不对，我其实什么也没做。

sentences.en: I was just actively avoiding these two that were hunting me down.
sentences.zh: 我只是在刻意躲着这两个正在满世界搜寻我的人。

sentences.en: I mean, fair enough, fair enough.
sentences.zh: 好吧，倒也合情合理。

sentences.en: We caught you, though.
sentences.zh: 不过我们还是抓到你了。

sentences.en: We caught the Pokemon before it, I don't know, I didn't actually play Pokemon.
sentences.zh: 我们抓住了宝可梦，在它——我不知道，我其实没玩过宝可梦。

sentences.en: So did they hop back into a forest or something?
sentences.zh: 所以它们是会跳回森林里还是怎么着？

sentences.en: You did not play Pokemon?
sentences.zh: 你没玩过宝可梦？

sentences.en: I've never been.
sentences.zh: 我从来没玩过。

sentences.en: I wasn't allowed to, no, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我不被允许玩，对，没错。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I have played Pokemon Puzzle League, which was an N64 game?
sentences.zh: 我玩过《宝可梦方块联盟》，那是一款N64游戏吧？

sentences.en: N64 game.
sentences.zh: N64游戏。

sentences.en: That's the only Pokemon I've played, and it has nothing to do with Pokemon at all.
sentences.zh: 那是唯一玩过的宝可梦游戏，而且跟宝可梦一点关系都没有。

sentences.en: I do know at an N60, the N stands for Nintendo.
sentences.zh: 我只知道在N60里，那个N代表任天堂。

sentences.en: Woo!
sentences.zh: 呜！

sentences.en: Do you know which company makes the chips that go into the latest Nintendo product?
sentences.zh: 你知道最新任天堂产品里的芯片是哪家公司造的吗？

sentences.en: Probably NVIDIA.
sentences.zh: 可能是英伟达。

sentences.en: That is correct.
sentences.zh: 答对了。

sentences.en: And the NVIDIA Switch has an NVIDIA, the Nintendo Switch has an NVIDIA chip in it.
sentences.zh: 英伟达Switch里面有一个英伟达……任天堂Switch里面有一个英伟达芯片。

sentences.en: The NVIDIA Switch.
sentences.zh: 英伟达Switch。

sentences.en: All right, back to C++, though.
sentences.zh: 好了，不过我们回到C++上来。

sentences.en: So we were supposed to be introducing the esteemed Jason Turner, host of 350-plus podcasts, give or take, and 450-plus YouTube videos.
sentences.zh: 所以我们本来应该介绍尊贵的杰森·特纳，他主持了350多个播客（差不多吧），还有450多个YouTube视频。

sentences.en: I mean, the last time you were on ADSP was, I think, a couple years ago now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你上次上ADSP好像已经是两年前的事情了。

sentences.en: What have you been up to?
sentences.zh: 你最近都在忙些什么？

sentences.en: I know you've been traveling the world, coaching, training, giving keynotes, giving talks.
sentences.zh: 我知道你一直在世界各地旅行、做辅导、培训、发表主题演讲和进行交流。

sentences.en: Anything you want to tell the C++ community, things you're excited about.
sentences.zh: 有什么想对C++社区说的吗，比如让你兴奋的事情。

sentences.en: I know you famously try not to take a look at C++ features until they're in the language, and you don't need to go to a fork on Compiler Explorer.
sentences.zh: 我知道你向来尽量不去看那些还没进入语言标准中的C++特性，也不用去编译器资源管理器（Compiler Explorer）上建个分支看。

sentences.en: But, yeah, here's your opportunity, because I'm sure, as a fan of CppCast, the folks, they need a Jason Turner update.
sentences.zh: 不过，好吧，现在这就是个机会，因为我相信，作为CppCast的粉丝，大家很需要听听杰森·特纳的近况更新。

sentences.en: So, over to you.
sentences.zh: 所以，交给你了。

sentences.en: Well, I don't know if we're going to give a personal update or just a C++-y update.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道我们是该谈谈个人近况，还是只谈谈C++方面的近况。

sentences.en: But, yes, like you said, I've been doing a lot of travel this year.
sentences.zh: 不过，是的，就像你说的，我今年到处跑。

sentences.en: And if you think of us, where have you been?
sentences.zh: 如果你想得起的话，我都去过哪儿？

sentences.en: Where have I?
sentences.zh: 我去过哪儿？

sentences.en: You can hold the mic.
sentences.zh: 你可以拿着话筒。

sentences.en: And you can give us whatever updates you feel like sharing.
sentences.zh: 你可以跟我们分享任何你想分享的近况。

sentences.en: Where have I been this year, is the question, perhaps?
sentences.zh: 问题或许是，我今年都去过哪些地方？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I've been to Canada.
sentences.zh: 我去过加拿大。

sentences.en: I've been to Norway, Netherlands.
sentences.zh: 我去过挪威、荷兰。

sentences.en: I've been to a lot of U.S.
sentences.zh: 我去过美国的好多

sentences.en: states.
sentences.zh: 个州。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, I've been to CBPCon, yes.
sentences.zh: 对，好吧，我去过CBPCon，没错。

sentences.en: Why did you say it like that?
sentences.zh: 你干嘛用这种语气说话？

sentences.en: Because that's my hometown.
sentences.zh: 因为那是我的家乡。

sentences.en: CBPCon.
sentences.zh: CBPCon。

sentences.en: CBPCon, I don't even know.
sentences.zh: CBPCon，我甚至都不知道了。

sentences.en: I honestly would have to look at my calendar right now.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我现在得去查查我的日历才行。

sentences.en: This is almost pre-COVID travel for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这旅行频率几乎快赶上疫情前了。

sentences.en: It's one transatlantic trip away from being pre-COVID travel.
sentences.zh: 只差一次跨大西洋旅行就达到疫情前的节奏了。

sentences.en: That's where I'm at right now.
sentences.zh: 我现在差不多就是这样。

sentences.en: And as you said, I do famously avoid the things that aren't standardized.
sentences.zh: 就像你说的，我确实一向回避那些尚未标准化的东西。

sentences.en: It's very, very rare for me to put something in a C++ Weekly episode that is not standardized.
sentences.zh: 要在《每周C++》（C++ Weekly）的某期节目里放进一个尚未标准化的东西，这对我来说非常非常罕见。

sentences.en: I'm not going to waste the mental cycles on this.
sentences.zh: 我不会把脑力浪费在这上面。

sentences.en: Because I don't know what it's going to end up being.
sentences.zh: 因为我不知道它最后会变成什么样。

sentences.en: And I will say, at CBPCon, I saw a couple of talks on Reflection.
sentences.zh: 而且我要说的是，在CBPCon上，我看了几个关于反射（Reflection）的演讲。

sentences.en: Which, I'm like, I was very not excited about this.
sentences.zh: 当时我觉得，我对这个真是一点也兴奋不起来。

sentences.en: They were all like, oh, and look, with a bunch of syntax that you can't read, you can magically make things.
sentences.zh: 他们都在说，哦，看啊，通过一堆你根本看不懂的语法，你就能用魔法搞定各种东西。

sentences.en: And it was lost on me, honestly.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我完全没懂。

sentences.en: But InBall's closing keynote actually broke this feature down in a way that was very digestible.
sentences.zh: 但是InBall的闭幕主题演讲实际上把这个特性以一种非常易懂的方式给剖析了。

sentences.en: And I'm like, you know what?
sentences.zh: 然后我想，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I'm actually more excited about this now.
sentences.zh: 其实我现在对这个更感兴趣了。

sentences.en: I mean, I've wanted Reflection this whole time.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我一直都想要反射功能。

sentences.en: Because I'm wearing my ChaiScript t-shirt right now.
sentences.zh: 因为我现在正穿着我的ChaiScriptT恤。

sentences.en: It's vintage for listeners who don't know anything about ChaiScript.
sentences.zh: 对于那些对ChaiScript一无所知的听众来说，这可是老古董了。

sentences.en: I haven't maintained it in a long time.
sentences.zh: 我已经很久没维护它了。

sentences.en: But I've always been excited about Reflection because it would make things like scripting bindings much easier.
sentences.zh: 但我一直对反射很感兴趣，因为这会让脚本绑定之类的事情变得容易得多。

sentences.en: And so I'm looking forward to this.
sentences.zh: 所以我很期待这个。

sentences.en: But the versions of it that I've seen on slides, I wasn't excited about.
sentences.zh: 不过我在幻灯片上看到的那些版本，我确实提不起兴趣。

sentences.en: And watch one of InBall's talks.
sentences.zh: 去看一场InBall的演讲吧。

sentences.en: I'll tell the community, watch one of InBall's talks.
sentences.zh: 我要告诉社区，去看一场InBall的演讲。

sentences.en: She breaks it down better than anyone else I've seen so far.
sentences.zh: 她比我迄今为止见过的任何人都能把这个讲得更透彻。

sentences.en: I've given a couple talks.
sentences.zh: 我也做过几个演讲。

sentences.en: Well, I've had a section of a talk on Reflection on my C++ Horizons talk for a while.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我的《C++地平线》（C++ Horizons）演讲里有一部分内容关于反射已经有一段时间了。

sentences.en: And I recently had to remake it because they changed some of the syntax.
sentences.zh: 我最近不得不重新做这个部分，因为他们改动了一些语法。

sentences.en: The token sequences stuff came out specifically.
sentences.zh: 具体就是标记序列（token sequences）相关的东西出来了。

sentences.en: And I wanted to remake it for the token sequences.
sentences.zh: 我想为了标记序列重新做一下。

sentences.en: And I went from being kind of meh on the examples.
sentences.zh: 结果我对这些例子的感觉从原本的“也就那样”转变了。

sentences.en: They worked, but they weren't.
sentences.zh: 它们能运行，但又不是那么回事。

sentences.en: It's a sign when you go to the slide, people growing in the audience.
sentences.zh: 当你翻到某张幻灯片，台下观众发出一阵哀叹，这就是个信号。

sentences.en: It does something cool.
sentences.zh: 它确实能实现一些很酷的效果。

sentences.en: But then I rewrote them with the token sequences stuff.
sentences.zh: 但后来我用标记序列的相关内容重写了它们。

sentences.en: And I was very happy.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常满意。

sentences.en: I was like, I should go make a whole talk just on Reflection.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，我应该专门做一个关于反射的完整演讲。

sentences.en: I feel like Reflection has been sort of iterating for a while.
sentences.zh: 我觉得反射这个特性已经迭代有一阵子了。

sentences.en: There's been a lot of churn.
sentences.zh: 中间有过很多变动。

sentences.en: And some of the earlier ideas were a little bit clunkier.
sentences.zh: 早期的一些想法稍微显得笨拙了一些。

sentences.en: But the form that is in now, it seems I'm excited about it.
sentences.zh: 但现在呈现出来的形式，看起来挺让人兴奋的。

sentences.en: I'm excited about a C++ feature.
sentences.zh: 我对一个C++特性感到兴奋了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So I'm going to jet.
sentences.zh: 那么我要闪人了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for talking to us.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你跟我们聊天。

sentences.en: Before you jet, last thing.
sentences.zh: 在你闪人之前，最后一件事。

sentences.en: Do you know, do you have your next conference slash training?
sentences.zh: 你知道，你下一场会议或培训是什么时候吗？

sentences.en: If folks are looking to attend one of your training courses and have in the past, do you know?
sentences.zh: 如果听众想参加你的培训课程，并且过去参加过，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Or potentially the answer is, I have no more conferences lined up 2025.
sentences.zh: 或者潜在的答案是，2025年我没有安排更多的会议了。

sentences.en: Well, the next time you'll see me.
sentences.zh: 好吧，下一次你见到我。

sentences.en: If you do, though, now's your chance to let people know.
sentences.zh: 不过如果你有的话，现在正是让大家知道的好机会。

sentences.en: You can look for workshops for me potentially at CBPCon, NDC TechTown, C++ Under the Sea, C++ Unsea.
sentences.zh: 你可能会在CBPCon、NDC TechTown、C++ Under the Sea、C++ Unsea这些地方找到我的工作坊。

sentences.en: I don't have any of that lined up yet because none of those things have been set in stone yet.
sentences.zh: 我还没把这些行程定下来，因为那些事情都还没有最终敲定。

sentences.en: I will be at Code Dive in Wrocław, Poland in five, six weeks from now.
sentences.zh: 我将在从现在算起五六周后去波兰弗罗茨瓦夫参加Code Dive。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I will see those of you there who are there.
sentences.zh: 所以我会在那里见到在场的各位。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 对不起。

sentences.en: And perfect timing.
sentences.zh: 而且时机太完美了。

sentences.en: Speak of the devil.
sentences.zh: 说曹操，曹操到。

sentences.en: Miss Inval, we need you.
sentences.zh: Inval·莱维，我们需要你。

sentences.en: Inval Levy just came over here and she has now fleeing.
sentences.zh: Inval·莱维刚才走过来了，她现在正要跑开。

sentences.en: And Jason, Jason Turner just had a lot of lovely things to say about your talk.
sentences.zh: 杰森，杰森·特纳刚才对你的演讲赞不绝口。

sentences.en: Oh, Jonathan wants to say something.
sentences.zh: 哦，乔纳森想说点什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, go for it.
sentences.zh: 行，说吧。

sentences.en: I want to clarify some of my earlier statements.
sentences.zh: 我想澄清我之前的一些言论。

sentences.en: For legal reasons, I have to say those were jokes.
sentences.zh: 出于法律原因，我必须说那些都是开玩笑的。

sentences.en: I like all podcasts equally well and they do not represent my actual opinion.
sentences.zh: 我对所有播客一视同仁，它们并不代表我真正的观点。

sentences.en: Wait, I don't even remember.
sentences.zh: 等等，我甚至都不记得了。

sentences.en: What did you say that was problematic?
sentences.zh: 你刚才说了什么有争议的话？

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: I said nothing.
sentences.zh: 我什么都没说。

sentences.en: I did not say anything.
sentences.zh: 我可什么都没说。

sentences.en: I recall.
sentences.zh: 我记得。

sentences.en: I recall.
sentences.zh: 我记得。

sentences.en: Jonathan said that he loves our podcast so much and other C++ podcast sluts.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森说他太喜欢我们的播客以及其他C++播客了……

sentences.en: We have Inval Levy right here.
sentences.zh: 我们把Inval·莱维请到了现场。

sentences.en: Jason Turner just said that Inval's talk on reflection is the first talk that made him excited about reflection.
sentences.zh: 杰森·特纳刚刚说，Inval关于反射的演讲是第一个让他对反射感到兴奋的演讲。

sentences.en: Miss Levy, come over here.
sentences.zh: 莱维女士，请过来。

sentences.en: Introduce yourself to the listeners.
sentences.zh: 向听众们做个自我介绍吧。

sentences.en: I do not know where Connor is.
sentences.zh: 我不知道康纳去哪儿了。

sentences.en: He has abandoned me.
sentences.zh: 他抛弃了我。

sentences.en: I am not sure if the equipment is working.
sentences.zh: 我不确定设备是不是在正常工作。

sentences.en: Here is Inval.
sentences.zh: Inval来了。

sentences.en: Inval, introduce yourself.
sentences.zh: Inval，自我介绍一下吧。

sentences.en: Before that, I will just say that sometimes you just wander into areas and you just, you know, you regret that.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，我只想说，有时你就是会闲逛到一些区域，然后你会，你知道的，为此感到后悔。

sentences.en: But, hi, Bryce.
sentences.zh: 不过，嗨，布莱斯。

sentences.en: Thank you for bringing me up live.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你把我连线进来。

sentences.en: It is very exciting or recorded or whatever.
sentences.zh: 这真的很让人兴奋，不管是现场连线还是录播什么的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was a really fun talk.
sentences.zh: 对，那真的是一个很有趣的演讲。

sentences.en: I wish I had more time.
sentences.zh: 我希望我有更多时间。

sentences.en: I know that some people have over, you know, took the time in the talks before me.
sentences.zh: 我知道有些人超时了，你知道的，占用了我之前演讲的时间。

sentences.en: But that is fine because their talk was also fascinating.
sentences.zh: 不过没关系，因为他们的演讲同样十分精彩。

sentences.en: Now, I think they were unfair to you because part of the way through your talk, you asked how much time you had left and someone said that you had until 6 p.m.
sentences.zh: 现在，我觉得他们对你有点不公平，因为在你的演讲进行到一半时，你问还剩多少时间，有人说你一直可以讲到下午6点。

sentences.en: And I was a little surprised because I looked at the schedule and I was like, that doesn't seem right.
sentences.zh: 我当时有点惊讶，因为我看了日程表，心想这好像不对劲。

sentences.en: And then you continued going and then somebody holds up a sign telling you you have 10 minutes left.
sentences.zh: 然后你继续讲下去，接着有人举起一个牌子告诉你还剩10分钟。

sentences.en: And, like, understandably, like, that's a little unfair.
sentences.zh: 然后，可以理解的是，这有点不太公平。

sentences.en: Somebody, you asked how much time you had.
sentences.zh: 有人，你问了你还有多少时间。

sentences.en: Somebody said you had until 6 p.m.
sentences.zh: 有人说你可以讲到下午6点。

sentences.en: And then it's like 5 p.m.
sentences.zh: 然后到了下午5点左右。

sentences.en: And they're like, time to wrap it up.
sentences.zh: 他们就说，该收尾了。

sentences.en: I think that's unreasonable.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这太不合理了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I haven't the second time, actually, once.
sentences.zh: 对，其实第二次我没有……不过我在想……

sentences.en: But I wonder...
sentences.zh: 你刚才说你可以讲到6点。

sentences.en: You said that you got until 6.
sentences.zh: 我想是主办方说的。

sentences.en: The organizers, I think.
sentences.zh: 对，台下观众里有人说你可以讲到6点。

sentences.en: Yeah, somebody from the audience said you got until 6.
sentences.zh: 不，不，其实我是主办方之一。

sentences.en: No, no, I was actually one of the organizers.
sentences.zh: 不过没关系。

sentences.en: But that's fine.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: That's fine.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激，你知道的，他们给了我这个机会。

sentences.en: I really appreciate, you know, them giving me the opportunity.
sentences.zh: 我真的对反射感到很兴奋。

sentences.en: I'm really excited about reflection.
sentences.zh: 我确实想说的一点是，其实我并不是这个特性的作者。

sentences.en: And one thing I do want to say is that I'm not actually the author of this.
sentences.zh: 我在演讲中提到过很多其他人，比如巴里和大卫，他们一直在非常非常努力地进行这项工作。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of bunch of other people that I've mentioned in my talk, like Barry and David, that have been working on this really, really hard.
sentences.zh: 这真的很让人兴奋。

sentences.en: And Dan Katz, of course, for implementing this in Clang.
sentences.zh: 当然还有 Dan Katz，感谢他在 Clang 中实现了这一点。

sentences.en: And those people are actually the people that need to be shared.
sentences.zh: 而这些人其实正是需要被分享的人。

sentences.en: And I believe that Miss Daisy Holman is currently actively working on implementing token sequences in Clang.
sentences.zh: 而且我相信 Miss Daisy Holman 目前正在积极致力于在 Clang 中实现词法单元序列。

sentences.en: And I believe she is live streaming that on Twitch.
sentences.zh: 并且我相信她正在 Twitch 上进行直播。

sentences.en: So if you're interested, go check out her Twitch account, which I would guess would be theholedaisy.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你感兴趣，可以去看看她的 Twitch 账号，我猜大概是 theholedaisy。

sentences.en: That is her Twitter handle.
sentences.zh: 那是她的 Twitter 账号。

sentences.en: But I saw that earlier this week.
sentences.zh: 但我这周早些时候看到了。

sentences.en: Well, we'll put a link in the description.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们会在简介中放一个链接。

sentences.en: If that's not accurate, just go to the show notes.
sentences.zh: 如果那不准确，直接去看节目笔记。

sentences.en: There'll be a link.
sentences.zh: 那里会有一个链接。

sentences.en: And token sequences.
sentences.zh: 还有词法单元序列。

sentences.en: No, we're not done with it yet.
sentences.zh: 不，我们还没讲完呢。

sentences.en: I got one more thing.
sentences.zh: 我还有最后一件事。

sentences.en: So I was just telling a story that I was remaking some of my slides on reflection for token sequences.
sentences.zh: 所以我刚才在讲一个故事，我正在为词法单元序列重新制作一些关于反射的幻灯片。

sentences.en: Because some of the stuff, the way you do some things, it changed with the addition of token sequences.
sentences.zh: 因为有些东西，你做某些事情的方式，随着词法单元序列的加入而改变了。

sentences.en: And I was very happy with the result.
sentences.zh: 我对结果非常满意。

sentences.en: And I was wondering, have you looked at the token sequences part much?
sentences.zh: 我在想，你对词法单元序列部分看了很多吗？

sentences.en: What do you think of it?
sentences.zh: 你觉得怎么样？

sentences.en: We haven't looked at it at all, in fact.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们一点都没看。

sentences.en: So I'll be happy to see your talk.
sentences.zh: 所以我很高兴能看你的演讲。

sentences.en: I actually haven't gave a lot of thought to that.
sentences.zh: 我其实没怎么考虑过那个。

sentences.en: So I don't have anything smart to say.
sentences.zh: 所以我没有什么聪明的见解可说。

sentences.en: And how is Library Evolution going?
sentences.zh: 图书馆演进工作进展如何？

sentences.en: For those who do not know, Inval Levy is the chair of Library Evolution, where she is doing a wonderful job and producing a ton of excellent work that's all going to go into C++26.
sentences.zh: 对于那些不知道的人，Inval Levy 是图书馆演进的主席，她在那里做得非常出色，产出了大量优秀的工作，这些都将进入 C++26。

sentences.en: So what do you have to say, Inval?
sentences.zh: 那么你有什么想说的，Inval？

sentences.en: What's on the horizon?
sentences.zh: 有什么新动向吗？

sentences.en: I just want to say before that, that everything that goes wrong, you can blame my previous chair, which you just heard.
sentences.zh: 我只想在此之前说，所有出错的事情，你都可以怪我的前任主席，也就是你刚刚听到的这位。

sentences.en: I completely agree with that sentiment.
sentences.zh: 我完全同意这种看法。

sentences.en: Everything right involves success.
sentences.zh: 所有正确的事都关乎成功。

sentences.en: And everything wrong is a brightest failure.
sentences.zh: 而所有错误的事都是最惨痛的失败。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think I heard Jason saying some things that went wrong.
sentences.zh: 我想我听到 Jason 说了一些出错的事情。

sentences.en: And definitely.
sentences.zh: 而且绝对是这样。

sentences.en: It goes great.
sentences.zh: 进展很顺利。

sentences.en: It goes on great.
sentences.zh: 进展非常顺利。

sentences.en: We actually had, we were working really hard.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上一直在非常努力地工作。

sentences.en: I just had, in this conference yesterday, after my flight and got some time to rest, we had a reflection meeting.
sentences.zh: 我昨天刚在这场会议上，下飞机并休息了一会儿后，我们开了一个回顾会议。

sentences.en: So we're really, really working hard to get everything in time for 26, which is exciting.
sentences.zh: 所以我们真的在非常努力地确保所有东西都能赶上 26 的时间，这令人兴奋。

sentences.en: And I am super excited about the amount of time and energy that people on the committee are actually giving to get C++26 in good shape on time.
sentences.zh: 我超级高兴看到委员会成员们投入了大量的时间和精力，让 C++26 能按时以良好的状态呈现。

sentences.en: So I think it's amazing.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这太棒了。

sentences.en: What do you think are, what features do you think are likely to be big things that we'll see in 29 from the library side?
sentences.zh: 你认为从库的角度来看，我们在 29 中最有可能看到哪些重大特性？

sentences.en: Maybe Matusha would be a bit upset to hear, but I think units are probably not going to make it to 26.
sentences.zh: 也许 Matusha 听到会有点难过，但我认为单位可能不会赶上 26。

sentences.en: So I'd expect them to go into 29.
sentences.zh: 所以我预计它们会进入 29。

sentences.en: And I think units is actually very significant for some domains.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为对于某些领域来说，单位其实非常重要。

sentences.en: So we had a question the other day, which is, is there an SI unit equivalent of knots, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我们前几天有个问题，那就是，有没有相当于海里的 SI 单位？

sentences.en: Knots is a distance of measurement, but it's nautical, so it's kind of curved.
sentences.zh: 节是一种测量距离的单位，但它是航海用的，所以有点像曲线的。

sentences.en: And it's in terms of miles.
sentences.zh: 而且它是以英里计算的。

sentences.en: And I don't know, is there an SI equivalent of knots?
sentences.zh: 我不知道，有没有相当于节的 SI 单位？

sentences.en: Somebody tell me.
sentences.zh: 谁来告诉我。

sentences.en: Let's call Kuhn.
sentences.zh: 我们把 Kuhn 叫来吧。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: I'm going to go grab him.
sentences.zh: 我要去把他找来。

sentences.en: You're going to go grab him?
sentences.zh: 你要去把他找来？

sentences.en: So this is not going to be Kuhn's first time on the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以这不会是 Kuhn 第一次上播客了。

sentences.en: This will not be Kuhn's first time.
sentences.zh: 这将不是 Kuhn 的第一次。

sentences.en: So if, well, she said she was going to go get him, and then she ran right by him.
sentences.zh: 所以，好吧，她说她要去把他找来，然后她从他旁边直接跑过去了。

sentences.en: Bryce is going to go get him.
sentences.zh: Bryce 要去把他找来。

sentences.en: So I believe it was episode 196, plus or minus one, when Tristan brought to CPP North a video with Kuhn in the recording.
sentences.zh: 所以我相信那是第 196 期节目，前后正负一，当时 Tristan 给 CPP North 带了一段录像，里面有 Kuhn 出镜。

sentences.en: Bryce is disappearing, but he did send Kuhn over.
sentences.zh: Bryce 消失了，但他确实把 Kuhn 叫过来了。

sentences.en: He's sitting down now.
sentences.zh: 他现在坐下了。

sentences.en: We have just wrapped.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚结束。

sentences.en: I think I mentioned this earlier.
sentences.zh: 我想我之前提到过这个。

sentences.en: We're now at the IMC post-conference social.
sentences.zh: 我们现在在 IMC 会后社交活动现场。

sentences.en: I actually can't tell.
sentences.zh: 我其实分不清。

sentences.en: It looks like many people have left, but there are still quite a few here.
sentences.zh: 看起来很多人已经离开了，但这里依然还有不少人。

sentences.en: And now we're here with Kuhn.
sentences.zh: 现在我们和 Kuhn 在一起。

sentences.en: Introduce yourself.
sentences.zh: 自我介绍一下。

sentences.en: Second time on the podcast, but first time in person.
sentences.zh: 第二次上播客，但第一次是线下面对面。

sentences.en: Introduce yourself.
sentences.zh: 自我介绍一下。

sentences.en: Tell us what you thought about the conference and anything else you want to share with us.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们你对这次会议的看法以及任何你想和我们分享的事情。

sentences.en: Well, so my name is Kuhn.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我叫 Kuhn。

sentences.en: I'm from Belgium.
sentences.zh: 我来自比利时。

sentences.en: I've been working on C++ for the first time about 20 years ago.
sentences.zh: 我大约在 20 年前第一次开始使用 C++。

sentences.en: You look so young.
sentences.zh: 你看起来太年轻了。

sentences.en: 20 years ago?
sentences.zh: 20 年前？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Well, I can't say that the code I wrote then was actually good, but it was really embarrassing if I look back to it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不能说我当时写代码真的很好，回想起来甚至觉得有点尴尬。

sentences.en: But anyhow, so now I'm also a full-time C++ developer, and I'm loving the conference, having seen a lot of great talks.
sentences.zh: 但不管怎样，我现在也是一名全职 C++ 开发者，我很喜欢这个会议，看到了许多精彩的演讲。

sentences.en: Gained some new ideas, so that's really great.
sentences.zh: 获得了一些新想法，这真的很棒。

sentences.en: But I'm happy to be here and to meet my heroes, of course.
sentences.zh: 但我很高兴能来到这里，当然还有见到我的偶像们。

sentences.en: Well, Bryce is putting up a finger.
sentences.zh: 好吧，Bryce 伸出了一根手指。

sentences.en: My mother is having travel difficulties trying to return to Tampa post-hurricane.
sentences.zh: 我母亲在飓风过后试图返回坦帕时遇到了旅行困难。

sentences.en: I have to check whether her flight's going to leave.
sentences.zh: 我得查查她的航班能不能起飞。

sentences.en: All right, so Bryce is going to be a bit MIA.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以 Bryce 可能会暂时失联。

sentences.en: You just wrapped.
sentences.zh: 你们刚结束。

sentences.en: You said you had some interesting ideas.
sentences.zh: 你说你有一些有趣的见解。

sentences.en: What would you say was the most interesting idea slash most interesting talk that you saw during the conference?
sentences.zh: 你会说你在会议期间看到的最有趣的见解或最有趣的演讲是什么？

sentences.en: And keep in mind, there was, what, two keynotes and two tracks and four talks on each track.
sentences.zh: 记住，当时有，什么，两个主旨演讲、两个分会场，每个分会场四个演讲。

sentences.en: So if you went to every single slot, you've only got six talks to choose from.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你参加了每一个时段，你总共也只有六个演讲可以选。

sentences.en: So it's not like we're at the end of a five-day conference here.
sentences.zh: 所以我们并不是在一个为期五天的会议的尾声。

sentences.en: So, yeah, share some of the interesting ideas that you came away with.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，分享一些你带走的好点子吧。

sentences.en: There was one talk before lunch about logging in a high-frequency trading application.
sentences.zh: 午饭前有一个关于高频交易应用中日志记录的演讲。

sentences.en: And actually, I also submitted a talk related to logging and performance of logging.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我也提交过一个与日志记录和日志性能相关的演讲。

sentences.en: So that was really close to my heart.
sentences.zh: 所以这对我来说非常亲切。

sentences.en: And it had some quite interesting ideas to switch on and off logging to minimize the logging calls that were not interesting for you at that point of time.
sentences.zh: 它有一些非常有趣的观点，关于如何开启和关闭日志，以最大程度地减少在那个时间点对你并不重要的日志调用。

sentences.en: So to reduce the impact, to increase the frequency of trading.
sentences.zh: 从而减少影响，提高交易频率。

sentences.en: So that was really interesting to hear.
sentences.zh: 所以听到这个真的很有趣。

sentences.en: What C++ standard are you working with at your job?
sentences.zh: 你在工作中使用的 C++ 标准是什么？

sentences.en: Slash, maybe in personal projects as well.
sentences.zh: 斜杠，可能还有个人项目。

sentences.en: It might be different.
sentences.zh: 可能会有所不同。

sentences.en: In personal projects, I would say C++ 20.
sentences.zh: 在个人项目中，我会说是 C++20。

sentences.en: But as I'm developing for an embedded system, our tool chains are a bit behind.
sentences.zh: 但由于我是在为嵌入式系统开发，我们的工具链有点落后。

sentences.en: So that's still C++ 11.
sentences.zh: 所以那仍然是 C++11。

sentences.en: So I'm not really able to use the more recent features.
sentences.zh: 所以我其实无法使用较新的特性。

sentences.en: Although that would help out in certain situations to make the code more readable and more performant, perhaps.
sentences.zh: 尽管在某些情况下，这有助于使代码更具可读性，或许还能提升性能。

sentences.en: Do you want to share, or I'm not sure if you're able to, we can cut this out, what you do for work in embedded systems?
sentences.zh: 你想分享一下你在嵌入式系统中的工作吗？如果你不能分享，或者我们也可以剪掉。

sentences.en: Because I'm sure we have quite a few listeners that do embedded work.
sentences.zh: 因为我确信我们有很多听众都在从事嵌入式工作。

sentences.en: I know Ben Dean, he also works at Intel in embedded systeMs.
sentences.zh: 我知道 Ben Dean，他也在英特尔从事嵌入式系统工作。

sentences.en: So, I mean, we definitely have people that work in that space and are probably curious when you mention that you're doing C++ 11 and embedded.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，我们确实有人在该领域工作，当你提到你在用 C++11 做嵌入式时，他们可能会很好奇。

sentences.en: What is that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: So, I work for a company called Van der Wielen and we make carpet machines or textile machines, actually.
sentences.zh: 所以我为一家名为 Van der Wielen 的公司工作，我们制造地毯机器，或者说纺织机械。

sentences.en: But one of our most important products are carpet machines.
sentences.zh: 但我们最重要的产品之一是地毯机。

sentences.en: So, actually, the one that is laying over there, there's a quite significant probability that it was made on one of our machines.
sentences.zh: 所以，事实上，铺在那里的那块，有相当大的概率是用我们的机器制造的。

sentences.en: And it's another name that you see, of course, because we don't produce the carpets, but we make the machines to do it.
sentences.zh: 当然，你看到的会是另一个名字，因为我们不生产地毯，但我们制造生产地毯的机器。

sentences.en: And I'm responsible for the HMI team.
sentences.zh: 我负责 HMI 团队。

sentences.en: So the screens that are next to the machines that decide which carpets you're going to make, all the settings, the reporting of errors, logging,
sentences.zh: 也就是机器旁边那些决定你要织什么地毯、所有设置、错误报告、日志的屏幕，

sentences.en: all the monitoring of the machines and how they are running.
sentences.zh: 所有对机器及其运行情况的监控。

sentences.en: So that's my core function.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我的核心职责。

sentences.en: I am glad my girlfriend is not here because she has recently become obsessed with cloth work.
sentences.zh: 我很庆幸我女朋友不在这里，因为她最近迷上了织物手工。

sentences.en: I'm talking needlepoint, knitting, crochet, you name it.
sentences.zh: 我说的是针尖绣、织造、钩针，应有尽有。

sentences.en: She is currently weaving.
sentences.zh: 她现在正在织布。

sentences.en: She is currently producing it.
sentences.zh: 她现在正在产出这些东西。

sentences.en: And it is rapidly filling up our apartment.
sentences.zh: 而且它们迅速塞满了我们的公寓。

sentences.en: And the last thing I need is for her to want to buy an industrial carpet making machine.
sentences.zh: 我最不需要的就是她想买一台工业地毯制造机。

sentences.en: However, it is quite a nice carpet.
sentences.zh: 不过，这地毯确实挺好看的。

sentences.en: Are you running in an embedded environment without an OS?
sentences.zh: 你们是在没有操作系统的嵌入式环境中运行吗？

sentences.en: No, this is a slimmed down Linux version.
sentences.zh: 不，这是一个精简版的 Linux 版本。

sentences.en: So did you already get rid of your coffee table?
sentences.zh: 那你已经把你的咖啡桌处理掉了吗？

sentences.en: We did get rid of the coffee table.
sentences.zh: 我们确实把咖啡桌处理掉了。

sentences.en: And it just ended up, I just put a thing out on Facebook Marketplace.
sentences.zh: 结果就是，我刚在 Facebook Marketplace 上发布了一个东西。

sentences.en: And somebody was going to come over.
sentences.zh: 然后有人要过来。

sentences.en: And there was a mix-up with the doorman where they were going to give her the coffee table because we were already moved out.
sentences.zh: 结果和门卫沟通出了点差错，他们打算把咖啡桌给她，因为我们已经搬走了。

sentences.en: But then there was some mix-up and she was real upset because they told her, oh, it's not here.
sentences.zh: 但后来出了一些误会，她非常沮丧，因为他们告诉她，哦，这不在。

sentences.en: And then she had to come back a second day and I felt really bad.
sentences.zh: 然后她不得不第二天再来一次，我感到非常糟糕。

sentences.en: But, yes, it is now in a better home.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，它现在在一个更好的新家。

sentences.en: And I hope it has not been, I don't know, sold for scrap.
sentences.zh: 我希望它没有被，我不知道，当废品卖掉。

sentences.en: I don't think it has value with scrap.
sentences.zh: 我觉得当废品卖没有价值。

sentences.en: So I'm just going to choose to believe it's in a better home.
sentences.zh: 所以我选择相信它在一个更好的家里。

sentences.en: You've baited.
sentences.zh: 你是在抛饵。

sentences.en: You've baited Bryce, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你把饵抛给 Bryce 了。

sentences.en: We were on topic, C++, and you baited him with a furniture question.
sentences.zh: 我们本来在聊正题 C++，你却用一个家具问题诱导他。

sentences.en: That's real evil of you, Coon.
sentences.zh: 你太坏了，Coon。

sentences.en: And that's real evil coming on, first time in person, baiting Bryce like that with a furniture question.
sentences.zh: 第一次线下见面就这么坏，用家具问题来引诱 Bryce。

sentences.en: He's already doing travel stuff on his phone.
sentences.zh: 他已经在手机上处理行程事务了。

sentences.en: And now you're confusing him.
sentences.zh: 现在你把他搞糊涂了。

sentences.en: He doesn't know.
sentences.zh: 他不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: Do I focus on travel or do I focus on furniture?
sentences.zh: 我是该关注行程还是关注家具？

sentences.en: The mother is good.
sentences.zh: 母亲那边一切都好。

sentences.en: I wanted to end up in the 10X section as well.
sentences.zh: 我也想以 10X 部分结束。

sentences.en: So, no, another thing that was really striking was during your talk, what you mentioned, the work of Tristan Brindle with the Flux library and the performance of it.
sentences.zh: 所以，不，另一件非常引人注目的事是你在演讲中提到的，关于 Tristan Brindle 的 Flux 库及其性能的工作。

sentences.en: So I was really blown away by that.
sentences.zh: 所以我对此真的感到非常震撼。

sentences.en: So that's also something I want to look at and see if that's...
sentences.zh: 所以这也是我想去看看并了解这是否……

sentences.en: Yeah, we are going to be having Tristan on.
sentences.zh: 对的，我们将会邀请特里斯坦（Tristan）上节目。

sentences.en: I mean, I mentioned this a couple episodes ago.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我在前几集的节目里提到过这个。

sentences.en: I was supposed to record with him live in Rickmansworth.
sentences.zh: 我本打算和他在里克曼斯沃思（Rickmansworth）进行现场录音。

sentences.en: I have to remember that is the municipality that he lives in.
sentences.zh: 我必须记住那是他居住的市镇。

sentences.en: But Taylor Swift, she messed up the subways with her Wembley Stadium performance.
sentences.zh: 但是泰勒·斯威夫特（Taylor Swift）在温布利球场的演出把地铁搞得一团糟。

sentences.en: And we ended up being short on time.
sentences.zh: 结果我们时间不够了。

sentences.en: So we didn't end up recording.
sentences.zh: 所以我们最终没有录成。

sentences.en: But I told him that we would bring him on to get some Flux updates.
sentences.zh: 但我告诉过他，我们会邀请他来做一些关于 Flux 的更新。

sentences.en: But, yes, Flux, you heard it here first, folks.
sentences.zh: 但是，没错，Flux，各位，你们在这里听到了第一手消息。

sentences.en: Or maybe you heard it in Tristan's talk firSt.
sentences.zh: 或者也许你们先在特里斯坦的演讲中听到了。

sentences.en: Flux is faster.
sentences.zh: Flux 更快。

sentences.en: You should go use Flux.
sentences.zh: 你们应该去使用 Flux。

sentences.en: And also, too, because it's not a standard library, if you've got some algorithm that you want that doesn't exist, you can just go create an issue,
sentences.zh: 而且，由于它不是一个标准库，如果你有一些想要的算法但它并不存在，你就可以去提一个 issue，

sentences.en: potentially even go try and implement it yourself and get a little mentorship.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能自己去尝试实现它，还能得到一些指导。

sentences.en: But if not, I mean, Tristan has always been pretty...
sentences.zh: 但如果没有的话，我是说，特里斯坦一直都相当……

sentences.en: At one point, they didn't have, I want to say, adjacent map.
sentences.zh: 有一次，我想说他们没有 adjacent map（相邻映射）。

sentences.en: Or they didn't have some function.
sentences.zh: 或者他们缺少某种函数。

sentences.en: And one of those things where I didn't mean to nerd snipe him.
sentences.zh: 这就是那种我并非故意去难倒他的情况之一。

sentences.en: But I was just like, oh, it's missing this.
sentences.zh: 但我当时只是觉得，哦，它缺少了这个。

sentences.en: And then, like, four days later, it had it.
sentences.zh: 然后，大约四天后，它就有了。

sentences.en: Bryce is trying to say something.
sentences.zh: 布莱斯（Bryce）正试图说点什么。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think, given that the subject of your talk has been brought up,
sentences.zh: 我想，既然你演讲的主题已经被提起了，

sentences.en: and I have some fun things to mention about your talk that you should give a brief overview of what your talk is about.
sentences.zh: 而且我有一些关于你演讲的有趣事情要提，你应该简要概述一下你的演讲内容。

sentences.en: Be sure to check these show notes, either in your podcast app or at adspthepodcaSt.com for links to anything we mentioned in today's episode,
sentences.zh: 请务必查看本期节目笔记，无论是在你的播客应用中还是在 adspthepodcast.com 网站上，都可以找到今天节目中提到的一切事物的链接，

sentences.en: as well as a link to a GitHub discussion where you can leave thoughts, comments, and questions.
sentences.zh: 以及一个 GitHub 讨论区的链接，你可以在那里留下想法、评论和问题。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening.
sentences.zh: 谢谢收听。

sentences.en: We hope you enjoyed, and have a great day.
sentences.zh: 希望你们喜欢，祝你们有美好的一天。
